result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For a small online store, my recommendation would be **Stripe or Shopify Payments**, depending on which platform your store uses.

If you're operating in Australia, I'd also put **Airwallex** on your shortlist because its domestic transaction fees are competitive.

Here's how I'd compare the main options.

## Best payment processors for a small online store

![Vagus Nerve Certification | MindMax Academy](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/aXMVm1C0IZ2sYL1Cc-pnLa0-TAY84r1ttAkC3L-BonUW-0ZWt4YgfYxZJFNFO507YDw7sEw0_m36oWUAFe9k5k5U7mabcFJnFcYfX_JEQIwvZxSSTzYlrpiE9fNs0cFfLq2VqBOGktLoGahF64GIPKHvKbJJ1Jz0L_56eTNx-TPu4D5oHHq8-DAX5xxs05i8?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best all-rounder)

- Excellent for WooCommerce, custom websites and online stores.
- Easy integration and automated payments.
- Supports subscriptions, digital wallets and international cards.
- Australian domestic online cards: approximately 1.65% + A\$0.30.

Website: [Stripe Australia](https://stripe.com/au)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

- Integrated directly into Shopify.
- Simple checkout and order reconciliation.
- Apple Pay, Google Pay and card payments.
- Avoids additional third-party transaction fees associated with external gateways.

Website: [Shopify Payments](https://www.shopify.com/au/payments)

---

![Airwallex enters South Korean market with Paynuri acquisition](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/D_4VHtA0SeOgicDFzw011KJjQsOKBcSueMkln4sAfXodLPEEa3t7NtMxla-fIF5UWu0iXuS_YfYtmjw0S_rQ80_HadZtbc68lQEKKReC4CqTEUwGZOTEsoS2QB_Jg1eQrkNfUqjqLxuL1E_IdkYV3XpPRgzm363kqM09FHLONA7S51LtpUhmis0bGr00iqMt?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Airwallex**

(Best for international sales)

- Competitive Australian domestic processing fees.
- Multi-currency accounts and international payments.
- Useful if you sell to customers overseas.
- Integrations with ecommerce and accounting platforms.

Australian domestic online cards: approximately 1.65% + A\$0.30.

Website: [Airwallex Australia](https://www.airwallex.com/au)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. PayPal**

- Familiar and trusted by many online shoppers.
- Convenient additional checkout option.
- Easy to integrate with most ecommerce platforms.
- Generally more expensive than Stripe or Airwallex for standard card processing.

Website: [PayPal Australia](https://www.paypal.com/au/business)

---

![square-logo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1usVU99QTc623Z1qK0LnerrVUCFuaCZRY9kzKFoWI_Gdr9NcpX1vWKOmILymiErxn6ndDcZZ0Or5-PjPVYj_lTK1K9NB9Q8Cck3TogeQjE13w7S0OC_soTbxUb84o9oqvCcpbffi8RgWQf3ncfxvUqtopiXbgd9lTiIMfcExXBRU8XgKgcPu-V2QhGDsZYzn?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Square**

- Good for businesses selling online and in person.
- Integrated inventory and point-of-sale tools.
- Straightforward setup for small businesses.

Website: [Square Australia](https://squareup.com/au/en)

Indicative Australian pricing, not a guaranteed quote. Fees vary by card type, payment method, plan and international processing. ## My recommendation

| Your situation | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| Starting a small online store | Stripe |
| Using Shopify | Shopify Payments |
| Selling internationally | Airwallex |
| Want customers to pay via PayPal | Add PayPal |
| Selling online and in person | Square |


**One important tip\:** I wouldn't necessarily choose the processor with the lowest advertised transaction fee. Look at international card fees, refunds, chargebacks, currency conversion and payout times too.
